name: [2x EVENT] +1 Stat Every Step
desc:
In this game, any time you take a step, you get points! You can spend points to upgrade your speed, jump, or size!
Complete obstacle courses to claim wins, which give you more points!
Can you become the biggest player?

Note: This game is in alpha. Expect bugs and changes.

scripts.script:
setclipboard("https://discord.gg/TR3quUFgT6")

local rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/rayfield"))()

local window = rayfield:CreateWindow({
	Name = "example",
	LoadingTitle = "loading",
	LoadingSubtitle = "automation",
	ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false }
})

local tab = window:CreateTab("main")

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local tweenservice = game:GetService("TweenService")
local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local giveStat = rs:WaitForChild("GivePlayerStat")
local upgrade = rs:WaitForChild("UpgradeRequest")

local container =
	workspace:WaitForChild("Jump Courses")
		:WaitForChild("1.1M Win Large Jumps")
		:WaitForChild("1.1MWinButton")

local targetPart

if container:IsA("BasePart") then
	targetPart = container
else
	for _, obj in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			targetPart = obj
			break
		end
	end
end

local toggles = {
	win = false,
	points = false,
	speed = false,
	jump = false,
	size = false
}

local function spam(loopfn)
	task.spawn(function()
		while loopfn() do
			task.wait()
		end
	end)
end

tab:CreateToggle({
	Name = "auto win [resets stats]",
	CurrentValue = false,
	Callback = function(v)
		toggles.win = v
		if not v or not targetPart then return end

		spam(function()
			if not toggles.win then return false end
			local tween = tweenservice:Create(
				hrp,
				TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),
				{ CFrame = targetPart.CFrame }
			)
			tween:Play()
			tween.Completed:Wait()
			return true
		end)
	end
})

tab:CreateToggle({
	Name = "auto points",
	CurrentValue = false,
	Callback = function(v)
		toggles.points = v
		if v then
			spam(function()
				if not toggles.points then return false end
				giveStat:FireServer()
				return true
			end)
		end
	end
})

tab:CreateToggle({
	Name = "auto upgrade speed",
	CurrentValue = false,
	Callback = function(v)
		toggles.speed = v
		if v then
			spam(function()
				if not toggles.speed then return false end
				upgrade:FireServer("Walkspeed")
				return true
			end)
		end
	end
})

tab:CreateToggle({
	Name = "auto upgrade jump",
	CurrentValue = false,
	Callback = function(v)
		toggles.jump = v
		if v then
			spam(function()
				if not toggles.jump then return false end
				upgrade:FireServer("Jump")
				return true
			end)
		end
	end
})

tab:CreateToggle({
	Name = "auto upgrade size",
	CurrentValue = false,
	Callback = function(v)
		toggles.size = v
		if v then
			spam(function()
				if not toggles.size then return false end
				upgrade:FireServer("Size")
				return true
			end)
		end
	end
})
